verdict.rationale: The pack shows official developer tooling adjacent to SDKs: a published OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, an official CLI in the Increase GitHub org, and a well-documented REST API. None of the evidence names an official language SDK or client library, so building against official SDKs is only implied, for example via generating clients from the spec. Missing for 10: any documented official language SDKs (e.g. Node/Python/Go/Ruby), SDK installation/usage docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
